{"consolidated_memory":"MULTIPLE INCIDENTS: Memory blowup in graph/store/adjacency.rs

All incidents manifest the same symptom (resident memory climbing with every batch) in the same file (graph/store/adjacency.rs, graph engine side), with the same repro method (load the dense neighbourhood fixture) and verification approach (module test block in graph/store/adjacency.rs). However, each has a distinct root cause and trigger:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-02-17]:
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: an error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate (PR #2151, branch fix/memory-blowup-1)
- Result: flaky test improved from 38 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-19]:
- Trigger: input list came in empty
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #4189, branch fix/memory-blowup-2)
- Result: backlog cleared 46 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 3 [2026-05-14]:
- Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it (PR #5219, branch fix/memory-blowup-3)
- Result: job runtime improved from 4 hours to 90 minutes"}
